wide-owner-body.text: Make this feel like a conversation, not columns of text.

wide-lead-body.text: The width is only part of it. There is no visible author, time, or activity between replies.

wide-report-body.text: Use the same reading width for the messages and composer. Keep live activity visible when reading older replies.

wide-reply-body.text: Next is the activity source. Thinking must come from a live event, not a guess based on old text.
